description: Consolidate dashboard session factory GET/PUT into ui/src/api/session-factory/, retire legacy createFactory/POST /factories surfaces, thin current-factory-definition wrappers, and document normalization-only and prompt-template boundaries—without changing operator-visible editor, import, or export behavior.

context.customerAsk: Retrigger if ui-session-factory-client-recovery (v1) stalls. Full spec: tasks/prd-ui-api-module-cleanup.md (U7 UI API module cleanup).
context.problem: Session factory HTTP is split across current-factory-definition and named-factory with overlapping GET/PUT, a misleading createFactory export, duplicate getCurrentFactory fetch logic, and unclear ownership for factory-definition normalization versus prompt-template routes.
context.solution: Establish session-factory as the sole HTTP owner for session factory GET/PUT with typed errors and tests; delegate current-factory-definition; migrate import/export activation off createFactory; document factory-definition as normalization-only; group or cross-link prompt-template routes while preserving existing URL shapes and UX.

acceptanceCriteria: All dashboard session factory GET/PUT uses ui/src/api/session-factory/ with { mode, factory } bodies and shared transport helpers.
Editor save and import confirm (replace current / create new named) behave as before, including stale-version and not-idle errors.
No production or integration test path issues POST /factories for factory activation.
factory-definition performs normalization only with no fetch-based network I/O.
Session-scoped prompt-template HTTP is discoverable under the session-factory family without changing route paths.
Quality gate: UI typecheck, lint, and targeted tests pass for all touched modules.

userStories.title: Session factory HTTP owner
userStories.description: As a frontend maintainer, I want one module that performs session factory GET and PUT so transport, paths, and error codes are not duplicated.
acceptanceCriteria: getSessionFactory(sessionID) issues GET to /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory via factoryAPIURL and currentFactorySessionPath
saveSessionFactory({ sessionID, mode?, factory }) issues PUT with body { mode?: REPLACE_CURRENT | UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE, factory } and version rules matching current editor save behavior
Typed errors expose STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, INVALID_FACTORY, INVALID_FACTORY_NAME, and NOT_FOUND
Colocated unit tests assert method, path, and request body for default and non-default session IDs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Editor save and load use the session factory owner
userStories.description: As a factory editor, I want saving and loading the current factory to behave exactly as today while the API layer delegates to the session factory module.
acceptanceCriteria: getCurrentFactoryDocument, saveCurrentFactoryDocument, and saveFactoryForSessionDocument delegate to session-factory without changing wire semantics
useCurrentFactoryDefinition and useSaveCurrentFactory keep existing React Query keys unless regression tests require a documented change
Stale-version and not-idle failures surface with the same user-visible messages in covered save-flow tests
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Import activation uses session PUT only
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want factory PNG import confirm (replace current vs create new named) to keep working without any legacy factory-create endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace-current import issues GET then PUT REPLACE_CURRENT with the current session factory name preserved
Create-new-named import issues PUT UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE with suffixed naming on collision matching today's confirm dialog resolved name
createFactory is removed from the public API surface (or throws in development builds only until callers migrate—prefer full removal)
App.import.test.tsx and import hook tests complete without any mocked or real POST /factories activation call
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser: drop a factory PNG, confirm replace-current and create-new-named both activate on default and a non-default session tab

userStories.title: Export and duplicate GET paths use session factory owner
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want exporting the current factory to keep working while the client stops maintaining a second raw GET implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: getCurrentFactory for export reads through session-factory or current-factory-definition delegation with no standalone fetch duplicate in named-factory
Export error mapping remains consistent for network, not-found, and invalid-response cases covered by export hook tests
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Normalization-only factory-definition boundary
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want it obvious that factory-definition shapes data but never performs HTTP.
acceptanceCriteria: factory-definition/api.ts contains no fetch calls and no transport.ts imports used for network I/O
Module-level documentation states normalization lives here and session HTTP lives under session-factory
Existing normalization tests pass without behavior change
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Session-scoped prompt template routes are discoverable
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt-template HTTP grouped with session factory routes so I do not search unrelated API folders.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt-template GET/PUT remains on currentFactorySessionPath plus workstation segment with no URL change
Either current-factory-prompt-template moves under session-factory/prompt-template/ or session-factory/index.ts documents and re-exports the sibling with stable feature import paths
Prompt-template hook tests pass for success, not-found, and network error cases
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
